commit.message:
8390825: C1 remove unsafe -XX:-GenerateArrayStoreCheck

GenerateArraayStoreCheck is a develop flag that allows C1 to omit
required runtime array store checks.  Since disabling this check
is unsafe, remove the flag for cleanup.  The default behavior is
unchanged.

Tested by Linux Fedora 44 x86_64 with no regression:
- GHA
- test/hotspot/jtreg/compiler/c1
